name: Skageflå farm above Geirangerfjord
why: Up from Geiranger to an old farm on a ledge 250 m above the fjord, opposite the Seven Sisters waterfall.
book: Free from Homlong; many go by boat to the landing below and climb from there.
dangers: Steep path above the fjord; some chains.

points.name: Skageflå
points.note: Grass-roofed farm buildings on a ledge high above the fjord.
